# josie.lol

> Personal website of Josephine Pfeiffer, Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat. Cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, mainframes, security, developer productivity.

josie works on infrastructure and security. she spends work hours on things like confidential containers, free time on porting distros to weird architectures, and contributing to CNCF projects. she unironically thinks s390x is cool and will argue about it. occasionally writes crystal, and likes electronics with transparent cases.

## About

- [Homepage](https://josie.lol/): bio, certifications, sameAs links
